info.title: Eldercare Edge Enrollment and Topology API
info.description: Canonical frozen v1 contract for edge credential administration, installation enrollment, edge-authored topology reconciliation, machine ingest/config access, and audited clip download. Server-derived facility, installation, and enrollment-generation identity is authoritative on every edge-bearer request.

x-contract-rules.identityAuthority: The authenticated eft_v1 principal supplies facilityId, edgeInstallationId, and enrollmentGeneration. New v1 requests never derive facility identity from a header, topology body, worker configuration, or environment variable.
x-contract-rules.timestampFormat: All wire timestamps are server-authoritative RFC 3339 UTC values with exactly millisecond precision and a trailing Z.
x-contract-rules.strictJsonIngress: Enrollment, topology, confirmation, and admin edge-mutation bodies reject duplicate keys at every nesting depth, invalid Unicode, non-finite numbers, unknown fields, and malformed UTF-8 before DTO transformation.
x-contract-rules.canonicalHash: Topology semantic bodies are validated, arrays are sorted by edgeRef, canonicalized with RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme, and hashed as lowercase SHA-256 hex.
x-contract-rules.authFailureDisclosure: Credential lookup, facility-code selection, inactive lifecycle, installation generation, and foreign-record failures use generic envelopes and one timing class. Messages do not reveal whether a facility, token, installation, snapshot, alias, or clip exists.
x-contract-rules.retryability: Only HTTP 429, HTTP 503, and client-observed network or timeout failures are retryable. HTTP 409 requires state refresh or operator action and must not be blindly retried.
x-contract-rules.credentialStorage: The server persists only tokenId, a non-secret prefix, HMAC-SHA-256 digest, lifecycle, binding, and timestamps. Raw bearer values are displayed once and are never recoverable from storage.

x-legacy-compatibility.authorizationBoundary: Legacy acceptance exists only for previously deployed shared edge credentials during the rollback window. It does not authorize a shared credential as an eft_v1 principal, does not apply to enrollment or topology routes, and is not an alternative in any v1 security requirement below.
x-legacy-compatibility.observability: Every accepted legacy request increments a route-only compatibility counter without credential, facility, camera, event, clip, or location labels.

routes.newCredentialBehavior: Header identity is rejected; the eft_v1 principal is authoritative.

routes.facilitySource: server-owned camera mapping; historical payload identity is ignored or rejected for eft_v1
legacy path parameter; eft_v1 requires an exact principal match

x-existing-inline-playback.note: The attachment operation in this contract is separate and does not alter existing inline playback behavior.

post.description: Precreates a PENDING_CLAIM installation at enrollment generation 1, binds the new credential to that installation and generation with clientInstallationRef null, and displays the raw bearer exactly once. The facility code is a selector, not an authenticator. A replay after the initial secret-bearing response returns only the persisted redacted result.

201.description: Credential issued; the bearer is present only in this initial response.

200.description: Exact idempotent replay; redacted terminal result only.

get.summary: List redacted edge credentials and installation bindings
get.description: Returns metadata only. Raw bearer values and recoverable secret material are never returned.

parameters.name: facilityId
parameters.description: Optional administrative filter; it is not accepted from an edge client.

post.description: Issues a one-time replacement for the same installation and enrollment generation. The prior ACTIVE credential enters GRACE for exactly 24 hours, then becomes EXPIRED. Rotation never changes installation identity or generation.

200.description: Exact replay with a redacted terminal result.

post.description: Transitions the selected credential to REVOKED at request start. Revocation has no grace period and is enforced on every v1 route.

200.description: Credential revoked or exact terminal replay.

post.description: CASes the expected generation, increments generation once, resets acceptedClientRevision to 0, preserves the facility server revision, invalidates pending omission previews, revokes all old-generation credentials, and returns a one-time pending replacement credential. The new client installation reference remains claimable only by that credential.

201.description: Replacement generation and one-time credential created.

200.description: Exact replay with a redacted terminal result.

post.summary: Replace a credential whose one-time display outcome was lost
post.description: Uses a new idempotency key and expected tokenId. A successful CAS immediately revokes the lost token without grace and displays a one-time replacement bound to the same installation and generation. It never recovers stored plaintext. A replay of the recovery operation is redacted; another replacement requires another explicit operation.

201.description: Lost credential revoked and replacement displayed once.

200.description: Exact recovery replay; redacted terminal result only.

post.summary: Approve a persisted alias ownership-transfer manifest
post.description: CASes installation generation and facility server revision against a complete immutable parent-child manifest generated from persisted aliases. A transfer changes only provisioning ownership and stable edge references; it never changes names, placement, activity, history, or append-only records. A nonempty transfer increments serverRevision exactly once. Mismatch is a zero-write conflict.

200.description: Transfer applied or exact stored result replayed.

post.description: Creates a bounded validation-only grant for the expected installation generation. Validation events remain excluded from ordinary event, alert, dashboard, SSE, email, outbox, and search surfaces; only validation endpoints may read them.

post.summary: Verify and claim an edge installation
post.description: Authenticates the bearer, selects its bound facility with the non-authenticating facility code, and CAS-claims a null clientInstallationRef. Exact replay returns the binding; another reference returns INSTALLATION_CONFLICT. All credential, facility-code, and binding failures use a generic response and equivalent timing class.

x-rate-limit.failureDisclosure: All limit and authentication failures preserve generic non-disclosure.

200.description: Installation claimed or exact claim replayed.

put.description: Uses snapshotId as a UUIDv7 idempotency key. Changed snapshots must advance clientRevision by exactly one and CAS expectedServerRevision. Exact snapshotId plus semantic JCS hash replays the stored response; the same ID with another hash conflicts. Semantically identical next revisions advance acceptedClientRevision without changing serverRevision. Reappearing EDGE identities reactivate existing rows; omissions are previewed and never hard-deleted.

x-idempotency.hash: SHA-256(RFC8785(validated semantic body with arrays sorted by edgeRef))
x-idempotency.exactReplay: Returns the immutable stored status and body without another write.

200.description: Snapshot accepted, including semantic no-op or exact replay.

post.summary: Confirm a stored topology omission preview
post.description: Compares confirmationId, digest, expectedServerRevision, generation, expiry, and the stored omission set before any write. A successful nonempty confirmation soft-deactivates only provisioningSource EDGE rows owned by this installation and increments serverRevision once. Product-owned rows and historical append-only records are never candidates. Exact replay returns the stored result without another increment.

200.description: Omissions soft-deactivated or exact confirmation replayed.

post.description: The eft_v1 principal supplies facility, installation, and generation. Camera ownership is resolved server-side. Facility identity fields are not part of the v1 body. Previously deployed shared-token clients remain a separately metered compatibility path and do not gain eft_v1 authority.
Marks the server-resolved camera online under the authenticated edge principal. No facility header or body field is accepted for eft_v1.

put.description: Resolves event ownership under the authenticated edge principal and stores bytes under a server-derived key. Client-supplied snapshot keys and facility identity headers are rejected.

get.description: For eft_v1, facilityId must exactly match the authenticated principal. A mismatch is rejected without disclosing either facility. The path identity remains only for old-client compatibility; it never overrides the v1 principal.

200.description: Current runtime configuration for the authenticated facility.

put.summary: Upsert a legacy-overlap edge camera mapping
put.description: Maps an edge-local camera reference to one canonical room and camera. For eft_v1, facility, installation, and generation come only from the authenticated principal; facility identity in a header or body is rejected. The separately metered legacy overlap may continue to use x-facility-id during the rollback window.

x-legacy-overlap.newCredentialBehavior: reject header identity and use the eft_v1 principal

get.summary: Read event and clip-export capabilities for a camera
get.description: Resolves camera ownership server-side. For eft_v1, the camera must belong to the authenticated facility and installation scope; no facility identity parameter is accepted.

put.summary: Upload immutable MP4 clip bytes and metadata
put.description: Uploads a READY clip using the executable legacy-overlap header contract. Camera and event ownership are resolved server-side and must match the eft_v1 principal. The request never accepts facility identity, a connection URL, or camera authentication material.

parameters.name: X-Edge-Event-Refs
parameters.description: JSON-encoded nonempty ordered array of unique lowercase UUIDv4 event IDs.

put.summary: Report a terminal unavailable clip state
put.description: Reports that clip export could not produce usable bytes. Camera and event ownership are resolved server-side and must match the eft_v1 principal. Facility identity is not accepted in the path, headers, or body.

get.summary: Download authorized alert media as an attachment
get.description: Separate facility-admin attachment route with tenant isolation, descriptor-contained access, Range and ETag behavior, private no-store caching, retention and hold enforcement, and a sanitized filename. The existing inline playback route remains unchanged.

x-download-audit.successfulGet: One server-generated operation row starts after authorized file-descriptor open and becomes COMPLETED on clean finish or ABORTED on disconnect.
x-download-audit.noAudit: HEAD, 304, 416, denied, disabled, unavailable, expired, deleted, or foreign requests create no download row.

head.summary: Read authorized attachment headers without a body
head.description: Returns the same attachment, Range, ETag, cache, and containment metadata as GET without opening a download audit lifecycle or returning media bytes.
head.x-download-audit: No download audit row is created.

sessionCookie.name: app_session
sessionCookie.description: HttpOnly product session. Operation metadata further restricts the required role or capability.

edgeBearer.description: Installation- and enrollment-generation-bound v1 edge principal. A legacy shared token is not authorized by this security scheme.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: UUIDv7 operation key. The server persists its canonical body hash and operation status. Exact non-secret terminal results replay; a changed body returns IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Unknown client outcomes are resolved from operation status, never guessed compensation.

AttachmentDisposition.description: Sanitized generic attachment filename without location or identity data.

InvalidSchema.description: Malformed or unsupported request. Code is INVALID_SCHEMA and retryable is false.

InvalidTopology.description: INVALID_SCHEMA or INVALID_TOPOLOGY. Includes missing/wrong schemaVersion, duplicate keys or refs, unknown fields, invalid refs, secret-shaped fields, facility identity, RTSP fields, more than one camera per room, or invalid revisions. Retryable is false.

EdgeUnauthorized.description: Generic EDGE_CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED or EDGE_CREDENTIAL_INVALID response with equivalent timing and no record disclosure. Retryable is false.

EdgeForbidden.description: Generic EDGE_CREDENTIAL_INACTIVE or FACILITY_BINDING_MISMATCH response. This includes revoked, expired, stale-generation, and foreign-scope principals where disclosure would expose state. Retryable is false.

Conflict.description: State or idempotency conflict. Permitted codes are INSTALLATION_CONFLICT, IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, CLIENT_REVISION_OUT_OF_SEQUENCE, STALE_SERVER_REVISION, STALE_ENROLLMENT_GENERATION, TOPOLOGY_CONFLICT, TOPOLOGY_TRANSFER_CONFLICT, LEGACY_MAPPING_REQUIRED, or CONFIRMATION_STALE. Retryable is false; refresh state or take explicit operator action.

ConfirmationExpired.description: CONFIRMATION_EXPIRED. Obtain a new preview; retryable is false.

EnrollmentRateLimited.description: ENROLLMENT_RATE_LIMITED. Generic failure timing and non-disclosure are preserved. Retryable is true after Retry-After.

AuthNotConfigured.description: EDGE_AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED. The host token verifier is unavailable or has no pepper; retryable is true.

AdminSessionRequired.description: Authenticated product session required. No administrative or tenant record existence is disclosed.

SuperAdminRequired.description: SUPER_ADMIN role required. No credential, facility, installation, or operation existence is disclosed.

FacilityAdminRequired.description: Facility-admin capability and matching tenant session required. Foreign and unauthorized clips are non-disclosing.

MediaUnavailable.description: Generic missing, foreign, disabled, unavailable, expired, or deleted media response. No download audit row is created.

ClipDownload.description: Full attachment. Creates one STARTED audit row after contained open, then terminally updates it on stream outcome.

ClipPartialDownload.description: Single byte range attachment. Uses the same one-row audit lifecycle as a full GET.

ClipDownloadHead.description: Full attachment metadata without a response body or download audit row.

ClipPartialDownloadHead.description: Single byte range attachment metadata without a response body or download audit row.

ClipNotModified.description: Attachment is unchanged; no body and no download audit row.

ClipRangeNotSatisfiable.description: Unsatisfiable byte range; no body and no download audit row.

InvalidMachineMedia.description: Malformed clip identifier, metadata header, timestamp ordering, state transition request, or JSON body.

MachineResourceUnavailable.description: Generic missing, foreign, disabled, or unavailable machine resource response.

MachineMediaConflict.description: Event ownership, immutable bytes, or state transition conflict; refresh state rather than retrying blindly.

MachineMediaTooLarge.description: Clip exceeds the configured immutable upload size limit.

MachineMediaUnprocessable.description: Checksum, length, duration, or media-type contract mismatch.

MachineMediaUnavailable.description: Clip storage is temporarily unavailable or lock acquisition timed out.

MachineMediaInsufficientStorage.description: The server cannot safely accept the declared clip bytes.

FacilityCode.description: Server-generated selector: NH- plus 10 uppercase Crockford Base32 characters, excluding I, L, O, and U. It is not an authenticator.

EdgeBearerToken.description: One-time bearer display only. The final segment encodes 32 random bytes as unpadded base64url. No raw example is published.

Rfc3339MillisUtc.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with exactly millisecond precision.

CredentialLifecycle.description: ACTIVE is usable; GRACE is usable only until its exact 24-hour grace expiry; REVOKED is immediately unusable; EXPIRED is unusable at request start.

ownershipTransferRequired.description: Present for validated revision-1 aliases that still require explicit SUPER_ADMIN transfer. Alias persistence alone never changes ownership.

retryable.description: True only for ENROLLMENT_RATE_LIMITED and EDGE_AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED server responses. Client-observed network/timeouts are separately retryable transport failures.

EdgeRef.description: Stable UTF-8 edge-owned reference. Unique within its entity kind for the complete snapshot.

OperationStatus.description: Clients resolve uncertain mutation outcomes from this durable status. UNKNOWN never authorizes guessed compensation.

graceExpiresAt.description: Exactly 24 hours after rotation for a GRACE credential.

redacted.description: True in canonical fixtures and redacted replays; false only in the initial in-memory delivery.

secretDisplay.description: A redacted replay marker; no credential value is persisted or returned.

TopologyCamera.description: Contains topology identity and display metadata only. Connection URLs, camera authentication material, and secret-shaped fields are forbidden by additionalProperties false.

legacyCanonicalSpaceId.description: Optional only for a validated first-generation revision-1 alias claim. It never transfers ownership by itself.

cameras.x-canonical-order: edgeRef ascending by UTF-8 code units before RFC 8785 serialization
cameras.description: Frozen v1 cardinality: at most one camera per room.

rooms.x-canonical-order: edgeRef ascending by UTF-8 code units before RFC 8785 serialization

edgeInstallationId.description: Must match the edge bearer principal; it is not facility identity.

clientRevision.description: Starts at 1 for each generation and advances exactly by one for each changed registry snapshot. Exact retries reuse the revision, path snapshotId, and body.

expectedServerRevision.description: Facility topology CAS value returned by the server.

floors.x-canonical-order: edgeRef ascending by UTF-8 code units before RFC 8785 serialization
floors.description: Complete topology. Client serialization and server semantic hashing sort floors, rooms, and cameras by edgeRef.

TopologySnapshotRequest.description: Facility identity, expiry timestamps, connection URLs, camera authentication material, and secret-shaped fields are forbidden. Duplicate edgeRef values are invalid within each entity kind.

reactivated.description: Existing EDGE identities restored after reappearance; IDs and history are preserved.

deactivated.description: Soft deactivations applied only by a confirmed, non-stale omission preview.

digest.description: SHA-256(RFC8785({facilityId, edgeInstallationId, enrollmentGeneration, serverRevision, sortedOmittedEdgeRefs, expiresAt})).

expiresAt.description: Server-generated and exactly 15 minutes after preview creation.

OmissionPreview.description: Contains only active EDGE rows owned by the same installation. Product-owned rows are never omission candidates.

manifest.description: Exact complete parent-child set generated from persisted same-facility aliases at the current revision.

RecordEventRequest.description: No facility identifier, connection URL, camera authentication material, or secret-shaped field is accepted.

oneOf.description: Sensitive machine-only connection value. No example is published and it must never appear in logs, topology payloads, fixtures, or browser responses.

EdgeCameraMappingRequest.description: Legacy-overlap mapping body. Facility identity, connection URLs, camera authentication material, and secret-shaped fields are not accepted.

message.description: Generic machine-media failure without foreign-record disclosure.
Generic non-disclosing session or capability failure.
Generic response shared by missing, foreign, disabled, unavailable, expired, and deleted media.
